currency.decision: Owner ruling: CAD. SERVICES.md is the canonical rate card; current hypotheses are $200-750 rescue, $500-2,000+ viewer, $750-3,000+ microgame, $600-3,000+ music world, $1,000-5,000+ procedural environment, and $1,000-4,000+ product configurator.
currency.note: Buyer listings may quote other currencies or hourly ranges. Those figures belong to the listing, not this rate card.
currency.rule: Record the currency actually received on the payment row. If a buyer pays in another currency, record both the received amount and the CAD equivalent with the rate used.

conditions.text: one real prospect or buyer accepts a bounded WebGL deliverable
at least CAD $20 equivalent is designated to EARNED_POOL

first_20_gate.note: No payment has been received through this kit yet. This gate is a loop-proof target, not a revenue target.

formulas.opportunity_ev: (net payment x estimated win probability) - inference spend - human-time allowance - delivery/revision risk
formulas.token_roic: revenue attributable to agent-assisted work / paid inference expenditure

metrics.note: Both formulas are defined and neither has ever been calculated. First computation remains a definition-of-done item.

scope_decisions.first_paid_job_scope: WebGL / Three.js technical-art work only until the first revenue loop is proven. UE5, TouchDesigner, Houdini and 3ds Max may supply transferable skill/evidence but are not separate first-payment Treasury service lanes yet.
scope_decisions.prototype_rule: Adjacent categories reuse the current Fabric, Product Motion and Industrial proof stack. Do not create a fourth prototype unless a qualified lead exposes a specific missing capability.
scope_decisions.industrial_rule: The current Industrial Loop is reusable proof, not an obligation to apply to the original high-value listing. Owner comfort, truthful claim scope and delivery confidence are hard gates. SEND / WATCH / DECLINE are all valid outcomes.
scope_decisions.scientific_claim_rule: Current Industrial Structural / Flow / Thermal modes are component coding, not CFD/FEA/scientific fields. Do not claim simulation or measured-data capability without real supplied data and bounded implementation evidence.

rules: MAKE THE CAPSTONE WORK -> IDENTIFY THE GENERIC PIECE -> SEPARATE PROJECT IP -> PACKAGE THE REUSABLE PROOF -> SELL A BOUNDED SOLUTION -> RETURN A CAPPED SHARE TO TOKEN TREASURY
The system optimizes for durable useful output per token, not maximum agent activity.
Freelance gigs are sidecars: they must never displace Choral Sheep P0 or an academic deadline.
Never package Melodia-specific characters, textures, music, purchased templates, third-party material graphs, or client assets as generic kit inventory.
A high dollar value never overrides poor scope boundedness, high claim risk, high delivery risk, or owner discomfort.
The first paid result matters more than maximum application count.

stop_conditions.authority: FIRST_20.md plus current Treasury scope decisions
items: three consecutive outreach batches produce no credible leads
a prospect asks for unpaid speculative production beyond a tiny assessment
the reusable-kit work grows faster than actual demand
the buyer expects claims or domain expertise the current evidence does not support
the owner is not comfortable making the commitment after reviewing the real listing
